[?2004h]0;naser@Naser: ~/lab19-1NaserQ8/pasl/example[01;32mnaser@Naser[00m:[01;34m~/lab19-1NaserQ8/pasl/example[00m$ cat parallel.cpp 
[?2004l#include <iostream>
#include <math.h>
#include "benchmark.hpp"

/***********************************************************************/

namespace par = pasl::sched::native;

static void double_rec(const long* source, long* dest, long lo, long hi) {
	long n = hi - lo;

	if(n == 0){
		return;
	}
	else if(n == 1){
		dest[lo] = source[lo] * 2;
	}
	else{
		long mid = (lo + hi) / 2;

		par::fork2([&] { double_rec(source, dest, lo, mid); },
		           [&] { double_rec(source, dest, mid, hi); });
	}
}

/*---------------------------------------------------------------------*/

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
	long n = 5;
	long xs[5] = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5};
	long ys[5];

	auto init = [&] {
	};

	auto run = [&] (bool sequential) {
		double_rec(xs, ys, 0, n);
	};

	auto output = [&] {
		for(long i = 0; i < n; i++){
			std::cout << "xs = " << xs[i] << std::endl;
			std::cout << "ys = " << ys[i] << std::endl;
			std::cout << std::endl;
		}
	};

	auto destroy = [&] {
	};

	pasl::sched::launch(argc, argv, init, run, output, destroy);

	return 0;
}
